sections.title: Homeownership
sections.intro: The standard homeownership rate, and the share of all homes that are owner-occupied, which drops in resort and vacation markets.
sections.blurb: Homeownership rate versus owner occupancy, with the resort markets where they split.

items.text: Homeownership rate. Owner-occupied homes divided by occupied homes. The standard tenure measure.
Share of all homes owner-occupied. Owner-occupied homes divided by all housing units, counting vacant, seasonal and rented-out homes.
Irvine 92620. 55.7% of households own and 53.1% of all homes are owner-occupied, a 2.6-point gap.
Mammoth Lakes 93546. 60.3% of resident households own, but only 22.7% of all homes are owner-occupied. 62.4% of homes sit vacant most of the year.
South Lake Tahoe 96150 has a 45.8% vacancy rate.

items.title: Homeownership Rate by Region
items.foot: Owner-occupied homes divided by households, by region. Statewide: 55.9%. Lighter bars are below the statewide rate.

sections.blurb: Retirement communities and institution-heavy ZIP codes.

items.text: 239 ZIP codes where householders 65 and older make up 50% or more of households, or 25% or more of residents live in group quarters
Care facilities, dormitories and other institutional housing. 867,623 Californians live in them.
Age-restricted owner communities, such as Laguna Woods 92637 (median age 74.9, 71.6% own), and ZIP codes dominated by institutions with a high group quarters share.

sections.blurb: Dense renter neighborhoods in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Oakland and San Diego.

methods.title: Census Release
methods.text: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates, released December 2025. ZIP codes are 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas.

methods.title: Coverage
methods.text: 1,803 populated California ZIP codes. PO box ZIP codes have no residents and no Census profile. Traffic from them belongs to the surrounding ZIP code.

methods.title: Precision
methods.text: Every value carries an ACS margin of error and is most reliable for larger ZIP codes. The Census top-codes income at "$250,000 or more". A blank value means the Census did not publish it, never zero.

methods.title: Regions
methods.text: Region figures are household-weighted averages of ZIP code values.

methods.title: Fire Tier
methods.text: The prime target screen uses the composite brush fire tier from the California Brush Fire Risk report, built from the FEMA National Risk Index (December 2025).
